title: Reduced effective resolution from averaging in attention
description: The authors note that the Transformer reduces path length to a constant number of operations at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, which they counteract with Multi-Head Attention.
canonical_description: averaging in attention reduces effective resolution

evidence.anchor: at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section~[REF:sec:attention].
